searchText: Haha, all of these are great, and it will definitely make sense to go with something like that for the eventual canonical prefix! For now it is probably easier though to stick with the more verbose one, as that is easier to modify and play around with (e.g. for replacing the entry point address) I put together a small tool (still a WIP) which will let us define some attack scenarios that an honest node may face when maintaining a mempool of AA transactions: https://github.com/lightclient/bazooka We can feed the victim these attack sequences over the wire and use built in metrics (in geth, pegasys, et al) to gather empirical performance results I'm curious if there are already tools similar to this. Nothing immediately jumped out at me when i looked originally <@!543900561460822016> You might want to ask in the geth discord, since the client devs probably have more intimate knowledge of testing tools.

excerpts.author: lightclient
excerpts.content:
I put together a small tool (still a WIP) which will let us define some attack scenarios that an honest node may face when maintaining a mempool of AA transactions: https://github.com/lightclient/bazooka

We can feed the victim these attack sequences over the wire and use built in metrics (in geth, pegasys, et al) to gather empirical performance results
